jina: Short title, commencement and application of this Constitution
maudhui: (1) The full title of this Constitution is the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania, 1977. (2) This Constitution came into operation on 26 April 1977. (3) This Constitution shall apply to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar.
vifungu: (1) The full title of this Constitution is the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania, 1977.
(2) This Constitution came into operation on 26 April 1977.
(3) This Constitution shall apply to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar.
